text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER NiFeCo oxide screen - routine calcination series B","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate state"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-glass-0412"},"comment":"standard FTO glass plate for OER screening"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-glass-0412"},"comment":"init per SOP"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"NiFeCo baseline film, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":7200,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard calcination step (within SOP range for oxide crystallization)","label":"routine_anneal"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0]},"comment":"select point for CP"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"chronopotentiometry at default rate"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":3600},"comment":"short stability check"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{},"comment":"update GP surrogate with new data"}]}
